keyword: how to follow up without being annoying

uniqueAngle.existingConsensus: Good follow-up is about cadence: the right number of touches at the right intervals.
uniqueAngle.keelClaim: Follow-up quality is a memory problem, not a cadence problem — the hard part is remembering why this customer mattered.
uniqueAngle.supportingReason: A relevant follow-up requires the context that never made it into the CRM; without it, every touch defaults to 'just checking in.'
